snippet.title: The Retro Exorcist - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
After about a year of silence, The Retro Exorcist has finally been given a substantial update, a soft "remaster" if you will. Everything is pretty much the same with a few new sprites and quality of life improvements.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4590750/The_Retro_Exorcist/

Itchio: https://chestpain-studios.itch.io/retro-exorcist
